title: Accounts Executive - Finance & Accounts
description:
Blue Tech Marine Services PVT LTD, a part of Bluebird Group, is currently seeking a diligent and detail-oriented **Accounts Executive** to join our Finance and Accounts team in Kochi. The role will cover day-to-day accounting operations, ERP coordination, cash and bank transactions, reconciliations, receivables, and maintenance of accurate financial records through to account finalisation.

**Educational Qualification:** Commerce graduate preferred; working knowledge of ERP software required

**JOB DESCRIPTION**

Ø ERP coordination and system support: Coordinate with ERP service providers to report issues, follow up on resolutions, support system configuration or process improvements, and help ensure the ERP system meets the company’s accounting and reporting requirements.

Ø Accounting entries and ledger maintenance: Record and review day-to-day financial transactions, maintain general ledger and subsidiary ledgers, and ensure entries are supported by appropriate documentation and posted to the correct accounts and periods.

Ø Invoicing and billing support: Prepare, verify, record, and track customer and supplier invoices, as applicable; check supporting documents and coordinate with relevant teams to resolve billing discrepancies.

Ø Accounts receivable and collections: Monitor outstanding receivables, follow up on overdue payments with customers and internal teams, update collection status, and escalate long-pending or disputed items to the appropriate supervisor.

Ø Petty cash management: Maintain petty cash records, verify bills and vouchers, record approved expenses, monitor balances, and ensure timely submission and replenishment requests in line with company procedures.

Ø Bank and account reconciliations: Prepare regular bank reconciliations and reconcile relevant ledger balances, investigate unmatched entries or discrepancies, and follow up for timely resolution.

Ø Payments and expense processing: Assist with payment preparation, expense verification, employee claims, supplier balances, and other routine accounting activities, ensuring appropriate approvals and supporting documents are available before processing.

Ø Cash and bank transaction tracking: Maintain accurate records of receipts, payments, deposits, and transfers; verify entries against bank statements and supporting records.

Ø Month-end and year-end support: Assist with closing activities, schedules, balance confirmations, reconciliations, and preparation of records required for account finalisation, audit, and statutory or management reporting.

Ø Financial data accuracy: Enter and update financial information in the ERP and related records promptly, maintain organised documentation, and protect the confidentiality and integrity of financial data.

Ø Reports and analysis: Prepare periodic reports on receivables, payables, expenses, cash and bank balances, reconciliations, and other financial information required by management.

Ø Internal coordination: Liaise with Finance and Accounts colleagues, operations, sales, procurement, and other departments to obtain documents, clarify transactions, and resolve accounting-related queries.

Ø Compliance and controls: Follow company accounting procedures, approval workflows, record-retention practices, and applicable financial control requirements; promptly highlight unusual transactions or discrepancies.

Ø Additional duties: Undertake other accounting and finance-related responsibilities reasonably assigned by the reporting manager, according to business requirements.

**REQUIRED SKILLS**

Ø Minimum 2 years of experience working with ERP applications.

Ø Good understanding of accounting principles, bookkeeping, ledger maintenance, and reconciliation practices.

Ø Working knowledge of MS Excel, including the ability to maintain schedules and prepare reports.

Ø Practical understanding of petty cash, bank reconciliation, invoicing, and receivables is an advantage.

Ø Strong numerical accuracy, analytical thinking, organisation, and attention to detail.

Ø Good written and verbal communication skills in English and Hindi.

Ø Ability to manage deadlines, maintain confidentiality, and coordinate effectively with internal teams and external service providers.

Pay: ₹25,000.00 - ₹30,000.00 per month

Benefits:

* Cell phone reimbursement
* Internet reimbursement

Education:

* Bachelor's (Required)

Experience:

* ERP systems: 2 years (Required)
* Accounting: 2 years (Preferred)

Work Location: In person

title: Finance Executive
description:
We’re Hiring | Finance Executive

**Location:** Cochin, India  
**Work Model:** Work from Office (WFO)

We are looking for a detail-oriented and analytical **Finance Executive** to **manage day-to-day accounting, billing, receivables, payables, financial reporting, and compliance**. * Manage accounts payable, accounts receivable, general ledger, journal entries, and bank reconciliations.
* Prepare and verify invoices, monitor receivables, follow up on collections, and maintain customer credit limits.
* Monitor operational costs, process vendor payments, and support cash flow management.
* Prepare MIS reports, profitability analysis, and budget and forecast reports.
* Ensure compliance with applicable statutory and tax requirements, including VAT and Corporate Tax.
* Support internal and statutory audits, financial controls, and ERP process improvements.
* Coordinate with operations, sales, and customer service teams to ensure accurate and timely financial transactions.

Requirements

* Bachelor’s degree in Commerce, Finance, or Accounting. MBA Finance or CA Inter is preferred.

* Strong analytical, organizational, and time-management skills with excellent attention to detail.

title: GDS Microsoft Co-Investments Lead Analyst - Supervising Associate - India
description:
Location: Kochi

Other locations: Anywhere in Country

Salary: Competitive

Date: Oct 12, 2026

**Job description**
-------------------

Requisition ID: 1744627

At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.

  

**Role Title:** GDS Microsoft Co-Investments Lead Analyst

**Alliance:** Microsoft

**Competency:** Co-Investments

**Function:** GDS ES Growth & Innovation

**Rank:** Supervising Associate

**Sub Function:** GDS Alliances Program Ops CoE

**The opportunity**

Microsoft is one of EY’s most strategic alliance relationships, helping clients accelerate transformation through cloud, data, AI, automation and emerging technologies. Within this context, the Co-Investment team plays an important role in bringing structure, governance and execution discipline to investments that support joint growth priorities with Microsoft.

The GDS Microsoft Co-Investments Lead Analyst will support the Microsoft Co-Investments team by coordinating investment governance, funding administration, portfolio visibility, reporting, stakeholder follow-through and outcome tracking across global and regional initiatives.

This role is suited to a structured, commercially aware professional who can translate investment priorities into practical execution support. The incumbent will work with Microsoft Alliance leadership, Microsoft stakeholders, regional alliance teams, solution area leads, finance, commercial, sales, marketing and GDS teams to help ensure co-investment activities are planned, governed, tracked and activated with clear ownership and measurable outcomes.

The role will also contribute to AI-led investment priorities across Copilot, Azure AI, Data & AI, automation and emerging Microsoft solution areas by supporting structured assessment, tracking and reporting of business value, responsible AI considerations and commercialization readiness.

  

**Your key responsibilities**

* Coordinate the co-investment governance model, operating rhythm and business review cadence for Microsoft-aligned investment initiatives.
* Support planning, prioritization and tracking of investment requests, funding decisions, approvals, utilization, risks, dependencies and outcomes.
* Support programs and initiatives aligned to the Co-Investments stakeholder agenda and Microsoft Alliance priorities, with guidance from senior team members and stakeholders.
* Work with alliance leadership, finance, commercial, solution area and regional teams to maintain visibility of investment progress, evidence requirements, approval status and key decision points.
* Prepare clear analysis, concise updates and leadership-ready summaries to support investment prioritization, governance discussions and timely follow-through.
* Develop and maintain investment trackers, dashboards, status reports, business review materials, action logs and governance documentation
* Develop and maintain investment trackers, dashboards, status reports, business review materials, governance documentation and executive reporting to support effective management of Microsoft co-investment and funding programs, including utilization tracking, compliance oversight, business outcome measurement and stakeholder accountability.
* Support business case development for co-investment opportunities, including strategic rationale, expected outcomes, activation approach, evidence requirements and performance measures.
* Track portfolio performance across investment themes, solution areas, regions, activation milestones, utilization, pipeline influence and commercialization outcomes. Track portfolio performance across investment programs, solution areas, regions, activation milestones, utilization, pipeline influence, opportunity progression and commercialization outcomes
* Coordinate with sales, marketing and solution teams to support go-to-market activation, enablement, awareness and adoption of investment-backed initiatives.
* Support AI-focused investment initiatives by helping assess value potential, scalability, adoption readiness, data and privacy considerations, and responsible AI alignment in a practical and consistent manner.
* Contribute to efficiencies, automation and standardization across co-investment workflows, reporting processes, document management and day-to-day operations.
* Maintain collaboration tools, SharePoint repositories and working materials to enable stakeholder coordination and audit-ready documentation.
* Partner with onshore Co-Investment and Alliance Operations contacts, Microsoft stakeholders and alliance leadership on strategic projects, special initiatives, process improvements and leadership requests.
* Identify risks, process gaps and operational issues that may affect investment delivery, and coordinate with relevant stakeholders to support timely resolution.
* Coordinate with Brand, Marketing and Communications teams where investment-backed campaigns, client-facing narratives, marketplace assets or enablement content are required to drive adoption, utilization and value realization of approved investments.

  

**Skills and attributes for success**

* Good understanding of alliance operations, investment governance, funding coordination, portfolio tracking and executive reporting.
* Commercial awareness, including understanding of sales cycles, pipeline reporting, business case inputs, utilization tracking and outcome measurement.
* Technology aptitude and comfort working at a business level across Microsoft solution areas such as Copilot, Azure AI, Data & AI, Cloud, Security, Business Applications and automation.
* Practical understanding of AI-enabled transformation, with the ability to support assessment of AI investment opportunities based on business value, adoption readiness, scalability and responsible AI considerations.
* Exposure to continuous process improvement, workflow standardization, automation, process documentation, internal controls and audit readiness.
* Strong Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint skills; Power BI, dashboarding, workflow tools and AI-enabled productivity tools would be an added advantage.
* Strong stakeholder management skills, with the ability to build trusted relationships with onshore stakeholders and operate effectively in a matrixed global environment.
* Strong problem-solving capability, analytical thinking, root-cause evaluation and mitigation planning, with the ability to work across multiple teams toward practical resolution.
* Good project management skills, including prioritization, tracking, governance, execution discipline, status reporting and management of multiple workstreams with competing timelines.
* Excellent written and oral communication skills, with the ability to create concise leadership updates, business narratives and decision-oriented materials.
* Experience working with alliance or partner programs in a professional services, consulting or technology-led organization; knowledge of EY and GDS operating models will be an advantage.

  

**To qualify for the role, you must have**

* University degree required; technology, business, finance or marketing background preferred.
* MBA or equivalent postgraduate qualification would be an added advantage.
* 8 or more years of relevant experience in alliance operations, co-investments, Microsoft funding programs, strategic operations, portfolio management, consulting or commercial operations.
* Experience supporting senior stakeholders, global cross-functional teams across alliance, sales, marketing, finance and technology functions. iFlexibility to support assignments and priorities based on evolving business requirements, strategic initiatives and leadership priorities
* Ability to operate effectively in a fast-paced, matrixed environment while managing multiple workstreams, competing priorities and stakeholder expectations.

  

**Ideally, you'll also have**

* Multi-domain exposure across alliances, finance, sales, marketing, operations, technology or transformation.
* Exposure to Microsoft ecosystem programs, co-investment funding, go-to-market initiatives, marketplace activation, Copilot, Azure AI or related Microsoft solution areas.
* Experience supporting strategic initiatives, leadership requests, governance improvements, process standardization and reporting automation.

  

**Technologies and Tools**

* Microsoft 365 productivity and collaboration tools, including Excel, PowerPoint, Word, Teams, Outlook and SharePoint.
* Working knowledge of Power BI, dashboards, workflow tools and AI-enabled productivity solutions.

  

**What we look for**

We are looking for a structured, commercially aware and proactive professional who can bring discipline, clarity and follow-through to Microsoft co-investment priorities. The ideal candidate will combine stakeholder confidence, operational rigor, analytical thinking and a practical understanding of Microsoft-led innovation, including AI-enabled growth opportunities.

**US ET or CT working hours are mandatory for this role.**

  

**What we offer**

EY Global Delivery Services (GDS) is a dynamic global delivery network that plays a vital role in advancing EY’s growth strategy. Working across locations including Argentina, China, India, the Philippines, Poland and the UK, GDS teams collaborate with EY service lines, geographies and sectors to deliver high-quality work for clients around the world. In GDS, you will have the opportunity to contribute to meaningful projects, collaborate with diverse teams and build capabilities across an expanding ecosystem of people, learning, technology and insights that support long-term career growth.

* **Continuous learning:** Develop the mindset, skills and confidence to adapt, grow and navigate what comes next.
* **Success, as defined by you:** Access the tools, flexibility and support to make a meaningful impact in the way that works best for you.
* **Transformative leadership:** Gain insights, coaching and experiences that help you grow into the leader the world needs.
* **Diverse and inclusive culture:** Be valued for who you are and empowered to use your voice to help others find theirs.

  

**EY | Building a better working world**

  

EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.

Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.

Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.
